craft_notes: Sthāyin: counting-joy (twelvefold, by tradition). Sanskrit first: name-series (nectar, crest, śakti-brahmā, drop-sound), proclamation, kila → L4 sets names line 1, proclamation+tradition line 2. Rows: row 2 (name-list uncut line 1); row 1 (tradition-last — kila closes as 'known' closes). Rupture: dash after 'tone' — naming done, counting sealed. Close: end-weight on receivedness ('known' — not proven, received). Minimal pass: 'tone' for nāda (singable sound-word, same doctrine). Read aloud: line 1 chimes (nectar/crest/tone), dash, line 2 counts (twelvefold/tradition/known). Rejected: 'music' for nāda — killed: tone is sound, music imports art; 'everyone knows' — killed: kila is tradition-says, not consensus.

lines: Nectar, crest, śakti-brahmā, and the drop-sound's tone —
the twelvefold wheel proclaimed, by tradition known.
l4.sanskrit_cite: amṛtaṃ śekharaṃ caiva śaktirbrahmā tathaiva ca / bindunādaṃ tathā proktaṃ cakradvādaśakaṃ kila

reads_against.argmap: The wheel is twelvefold, proclaimed by tradition — nectar, crest, śakti-brahmā, drop-sound among its names.
c1_essence: Nectar, crest, śakti-brahmā, drop-sound — the twelvefold wheel proclaimed.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta strained toward bhayānaka (wonder edged with fear)
